How Talking Tom Gold Run works Your character runs forward automatically across 3 lanes. Move left and right to avoid obstacles. Jump over low hazards and slide under signs and barriers. At first, the obstacles are simple. Then they start coming closer together. Trucks block one lane while barriers close another, leaving you a split second to react . Some rows of gold bars sit in dangerous spots on purpose, tempting you to quickly switch lanes for more gold. The longer you survive, the faster the traffic, barriers and lane changes start coming at you.. Staying alive is more about reacting quickly when the road suddenly changes . Crashing usually ends the run instantly unless you have protection from items like the Helmet. Controls Desktop: Left/Right arrow keys: Switch lanes Up arrow: Jump Down arrow: Slide Mobile: Swipe left/right: Switch lanes Swipe up: Jump Swipe down: Slide Boss fights Roy Rakoon does not just run away. Sometimes he shows up in a truck and starts throwing obstacles and bombs onto the road while you chase him. During these sections, the run turns into a mini boss fight . You dodge his attacks and kick chili bombs back toward Roy's truck. Beat Roy and you earn huge piles of gold bars and diamonds. Building homes Every gold bar you collect helps upgrade homes for Tom and his friends. Upgrading your home helps you earn more points during runs. Completing a home unlocks a new character and opens another world to run through. This means even short runs help you unlock new stuff. Worlds There are 8 worlds in total . You unlock new worlds by completing homes. Tom's House : Suburban streets with cars, trucks and road barriers. The starting world. Angela's House : City setting with tighter lanes. Hank's Home : A tropical island world. Ginger's Forest Fun : Woodland environment with forest obstacles like tree logs and rocks. Ben's Adventure : Unlocked deeper into the game. Tom's Snow Ride : Winter setting with icy obstacles. Venice Canals : Waterside streets inspired by Venice. China Dragon World : Vibrant world with a Chinese festival theme. Characters There are 6 playable characters in Talking Tom Gold Run. You start as Tom and unlock the rest by fully upgrading each character's home. It's the key to survival and the source of endless fails. title: Slice Master
controls: Mouse click to launch the knife. Tap to launch the knife.
intro: Slice Master is a skill game where you click to control a knife as it flies through the air. Slice items like fruits, cheeseburgers and more to earn points, but watch out for the purple spikes that will end your run.
description: About Slice Master Every click sends you spinning through the air to slice fruits, foods and other objects . But one bad spin into spikes ends the run instantly. Play Slice Master for free at Poki and see if your skills are as sharp as the knife! How Slice Master works As the knife spins through the air, land on objects to cut through them and click to launch yourself toward the next target. Each slice adds to your score , but hazards like the pink spikes or gaps can instantly end the run if you click too early or too late. Most runs fail by a fraction of a second. If you hesitate slightly on when to click, you hit the pink spikes or fly past the objects. Adjust your timing by clicking slightly earlier , and suddenly you're slicing most objects and avoiding spikes at the same time. Controls Every move in Slice Master is controlled by a single action: Desktop: Click the left mouse button Mobile: Tap on the game screen Unlock new knives Earn cash during strong runs to unlock all 9 knives , each one showing how far you've made it since the start of the game. You start with the standard kitchen knife. The first unlock will cost you $5k, and they become more expensive over time . New knives don't make the game easier, as they are just for show. Only better timing lets you go farther and get higher scores. Getting higher scores in Slice Master Your final landing determines how much your score is multiplied. Landing on the right spot can massively boost your score. You can increase your score by landing one of the following multipliers: x2 x3 x5 x10 x25 x50 This works by taking the amount of cash you earned in the round and multiplying it by this number. description: How Steal a Brainrot works You start off with nothing but a stick and a base. Once you leave the safezone, you can buy Brainrots and add them to your base. Each one earns money over time, which you can spend on gear and other Brainrots. A standard base holds 8 characters , so the more you own, the more money you earn. Your base lock protects your Brainrots for 50 seconds. Keep an eye on the timer, because other players may be standing nearby, waiting for the exact moment it switches off. When they rush inside, chase them down and hit them before they escape. Press the lock button after a thief enters to trap them inside. Stealing from another player is where things get tense. Wait for their lock to drop then slip inside and grab one of their rarest Brainrots. The moment you pick it up, you move more slowly and the owner will come after you. That short run back to your base can quickly turn into a full chase, with other players trying to knock the Brainrot from your hands. Reach your base and the stolen Brainrot joins your collection. If the owner hits you first, you drop it. Decide whether to grab a Brainrot near the entrance or head deeper inside. Controls Desktop: Move: WASD or arrow keys Buy or interact: E Attack: Click with the mouse Mobile: Move: on-screen joystick Buy or interact: tap the on-screen button Brainrots Brainrots are characters you can buy that earn money while they stand in your base. There are 80 to collect , from Common Brainrots such as Tung Tung Sahur and Ballerina Cappuccina to Celestial Brainrots such as Skibidi Toilet and Dug Dug Dug . Rarer Brainrots earn more money each second. Gear Gear helps you defend your base from thieves trying to escape with stolen Brainrots. You can also use gear while stealing . Knock other players down or turn invisible to escape. You begin with a basic stick and can unlock 16 more items from the safe-zone shop . Extra items can also appear inside your base. title: Run 3
controls: Left arrow, Right arrow to move sideways. Up arrow or Spacebar to jump. Hold the jump key to increase distance.
intro: Run 3 is a space-themed running game where you guide a small alien through floating tunnels filled with gaps and collapsing tiles. Play in Endless mode to run forever or Explore mode to unlock new characters.
description: About Run 3 Miss a jump and you drift into space. Run onto a wall and gravity rotates, turning that wall into your new floor so you keep running on a different side of the tunnel. In Run 3, some tiles crumble, while ice tiles force earlier jumps. If you jump the same way every time, you will fall. Play Run 3 for free at Poki and see how far you can go before the tunnels make you miss a jump. How Run 3 works You run automatically. Because you cannot stop moving, every landing must prepare the next jump. Line yourself up and time your jumps so that every landing gets you ready for the next platform. Run 3 is about looking ahead before you land. Move left or right to prepare your next landing, not just to avoid falling. Jump to clear gaps, but focus on where you will land next. Run onto walls to rotate gravity and continue along a new surface. Collapsing tiles remove safe ground quickly, so waiting too long usually causes you to fall. Ice requires earlier jumps because of increased speed, while conveyors demand delayed timing based on which way they move. Controls Desktop: Move sideways: Left / Right arrows Jump: Up arrow / Space Mobile: Use the on-screen controls to move and jump. Holding jump increases distance . Short taps help control smaller adjustments when precision matters more than speed. Run 3 game modes Run 3 includes 2 game modes that change how you play. Explore Mode: Move through hundreds of connected levels and revisit paths to practise difficult sections. This mode lets you see how surfaces change your jumps on each level. Infinite Mode: Endless runs focused on survival and collecting Power Cells. Playing repeatedly lets you react faster to new tunnel layouts, making this the best mode for improving consistency. Block Blast mechanic A Block Blast happens when you completely fill a horizontal row or a vertical column . This is the main way you clear space in Blocky Blast Puzzle . When a row or column is completed, the blocks disappear instantly, creating room for future placements. The game clearly highlights when a move will trigger a Block Blast, so you can spot clears before placing the block . Bigger clears happen when multiple rows or columns are completed at once. Blocky Blast gameplay Gameplay moves in a simple loop where you place blocks, clear space, and place new ones again. Each round, you are given 3 blocks . To keep playing, all 3 must be placed somewhere on the board. Where you place a block now can make the next few moves easier or harder. Clean placements leave more empty space for the next blocks. Rushed moves often feel fine at first, then suddenly leave no place for the next set of blocks. Controls Blocky Blast Puzzle uses simple drag-and-drop controls. Each clear gives you 10 points , and your score goes up as you clear more rows and columns. The biggest score jumps happen when Block Blasts happen one after another. One clear leads to another, the board stays open, and your score starts climbing faster before you notice. Combos Combos trigger when you clear rows or columns across several moves without letting the board fill up with no clear rows. Each successful clear increases your combo count. Combos act as a multiplier . The higher your combo, the more points each clear is worth. If no row or column is cleared within 3 moves , the combo resets, reducing how many points you earn and making it harder to keep space open. Moving hazards: Spikes, saws and walls often activate after you move near them. Standing still for a split second can reveal the pattern. Fake safe paths: The obvious route is often the trap. Expect the level to change the moment you feel safe. Even the exit door can move or turn into a trap Gravity or physics shifts: Some stages alter how jumping works by making you jump extra high. Timing matters more than speed and jumping too fast can send you flying past the platform. Rule-breaking stages: Some levels suddenly let you jump as many times as you want or move differently than before. Level Devil worlds Level Devil has over 200 levels that are spread across 3 increasingly difficult worlds . Levels are organised into doors. Each door contains 5 short stages built around a theme such as spikes, coins or movement tricks. Clear all 5 to move forward. The final door of each world ends with longer stages that mix several traps together. Level Devil: Simple jumps turn into traps. Floors disappear, spikes move mid-air, and coins explode. You quickly learn to test every platform before jumping onto it. Level Devil-er: This world adds 16 doors packed with harder tricks. Bullets

Each time you buy the same ball again, its price goes up. Ball Initial price What it does Basic Ball $25 Bounces around and breaks bricks it hits Plasma Ball $200 Hits one brick and damages nearby bricks too Sniper Ball $1,500 Aims for the closest brick instead of bouncing around Scatter Ball $10,000 Splits into smaller balls when it hits a brick Cannonball $75,000 Smashes through weaker bricks Poison Ball $75,000 Poisons bricks so every ball hurts them more Power-ups Power-ups help you break bricks faster for 30 seconds. You unlock them by breaking more bricks , starting at 600 bricks, then 1,200 bricks and higher. title: The Impossible Quiz
controls: Mouse click to select answers and interact with on-screen elements.
intro: The Impossible Quiz is a brain game that will trick you every chance it gets! The questions have a hidden meaning and the correct answer is not always the most obvious choice. Can you complete all 110 impossible questions?
description: About The Impossible Quiz It looks like other quiz games, then immediately proves it isn't. Obvious answers rarely work. It feels random at first, but there is a clear pattern to how the game punishes mistakes. Play The Impossible Quiz for free at Poki and second-guess everything! How The Impossible Quiz works The Impossible Quiz runs through 110 questions. Most players don't see past the first 20-30 questions without restarting several times - so don't give up if you fail, it's part of the game! You begin with three lives , and every wrong decision removes one. Losing all three ends the run immediately. Most questions aren't asking what you think they're asking . One word or symbol can completely change what the question means. Other questions hide clues on the screen, and missing them often costs you a life. Look for clickable elements hidden in the background or clues placed outside the answer buttons. There are two other things you need to watch out for in The Impossible Quiz: Skips and Bombs. Skips: There are 7 Skips to collect while playing The Impossible Quiz. They let you bypass a question that's costing you lives, but wasting them early can ruin a good run later. You will find them as you progress, often tied to specific questions or hidden on screen. Bombs: Some questions introduce a bomb with a strict time limit from 10 seconds to 1 second. Bombs force you to think while the clock actively works against you. Panic clicking almost always makes things worse. Can you beat The Impossible Quiz without answers? Yes, you absolutely can! Despite how unfair it seems, the quiz is not random . Most questions reward noticing repeated tricks and small details on the screen. Many players look for answers or Impossible Quiz walkthroughs after repeated failures, but following a step-by-step guide removes the skill element . Progress comes from failing and getting a little further each time. Players who improve over time learn which clicks get them punished, so later questions feel less random. How to get further in The Impossible Quiz These tips help you keep your lives for longer and reach deeper into the quiz. Read the question like it's trying to trick you , because it usually is. The wording matters as much as the answers. Don't rush clicks. Some questions punish speed more than wrong logic. Watch the whole screen , not just the answer buttons. Visual cues are part of the puzzle. Expect the rules to change. If something feels obvious, it probably isn't. Remember patterns. Writing things down won't help when the rules change again. Use your skips sparingly. They will come in handy later in the game. Who created The Impossible Quiz? The Impossible Quiz was created by Splapp-Me-Do and first released in 2007 as a Flash game. It became a cult classic thanks to its unusual humour and its habit of breaking the rules. Many questions reflect the creator's humour and internet culture at the time, which explains why the rules often feel intentionally unfair

title: Monkey Mart
controls: Mouse click the fullscreen button to enter fullscreen.
intro: Monkey Mart is a management game where you run your own store. Grow crops, take care of animals, stock shelves, upgrade your store and hire other monkeys to help out as you unlock more marts with different things to sell.
description: About Monkey Mart In this idle game you grow crops, stock shelves, serve customers and unlock new aisles to sell more kinds of items. At first, everything feels relaxed: One shelf, one crop, one queue. Then customers arrive faster and you start harvesting crops while other shelves already need refilling. To keep up with your customers, you upgrade your shop and expand your crops. Play Monkey Mart for free at Poki and see how long you can keep shelves stocked and queues moving. How Monkey Mart works In Monkey Mart it's all about not standing still . You guide your monkey to the right place and the job starts on its own. Stand by crops to harvest them. Carry produce to shelves to restock items. Wait at the cash register to collect money from customers. There is no pause button. While you finish one job, another is already waiting. Customers and store flow As customers enter the mart, they will grab what they need and queue at the till. When shelves are full, everything runs smoothly. When items run out, the queues start to get longer and longer. Occasionally, rowdy monkeys knock items off shelves, leaving small messes behind. You have to decide quickly: clean up now or keep everything running. Now, more and more jobs appear at the same time. The shop never stops completely, even short delays can empty shelves and slow queues. Managing monkey workers As the mart expands, you can hire monkey workers to help do jobs for you. Cashiers handle the register so money keeps flowing Assistants harvest crops and stock shelves Farmers collect produce from animals Chefs prepare high-value items like popcorn, yoghurt, and coffee Workers make the shop easier to manage as you unlock multiple aisles, but they can slow down as well. They tire quickly and fall asleep mid-task, causing queues to build up and shelves to empty if ignored. When that happens, you choose whether to wake them up or step in to take over and do the job yourself. Producing and processing items You start with simple products like bananas and corn , then unlock appliances. Appliances help you earn more money by turning basic items into ones worth more, like yoghurt, popcorn, coffee and baked goods. Crops and animals Bananas can be sold as-is or turned into yoghurt. Corn can be sold, fed to animals or made into popcorn. Wheat becomes flour for baked goods. Coffee beans can be sold raw, ground, or brewed. Cocoa beans can be sold or turned into chocolate. Your animals need to eat corn before they produce eggs or milk , adding more jobs you need to watch closely. Unlocking new marts There are 6 marts to unlock. To get a new mart, you must finish unlocking everything in your current mart like aisles and appliances. Each new mart introduces new shop designs and new products. title: Drive Mad
controls: Right arrow to move forward. Left arrow to move backward. Tap and hold the arrows to move forward and backward.
intro: Drive Mad is a physics-based car game that tests how well you can control your car on increasingly difficult levels. From simple jumps to zero gravity and everything in between, driving steady matters more than speed.
description: About Drive Mad In Drive Mad, balance matters more than speed . Going fast in this physics-based Car Games feels tempting, but staying in control keeps the car upright through jumps and landings. With over 2.5 million player upvotes , Drive Mad stands out as a Poki exclusive built for players looking for that " just one more round " feeling. How to play Drive Mad To Play Drive Mad, you need to master braking and acceleration . The car tilts forward when you accelerate and backward when you brake. Use this to control your angle mid-air and on slopes. The first 10-15 levels teach balance and timing. After that, the difficulty ramps up so you better learn from your mistakes fast. Controls There are only 2 controls to master: acceleration and braking/reversing. This simplicity means mistakes show up fast, so timing matters. Desktop: Press the right key to move forward and the left key to move backwards. Mobile: Tap and hold the arrows to move forward and backwards. Short taps let you save bad landings and turn near-crashes into perfect runs. Hold the button too long and momentum takes over, turning a clean run into a crash in seconds. Drive Mad features Each feature changes how the level plays, catching you out when you get comfortable . Levels and worlds Drive Mad has 3 worlds and 250 levels . To finish them all, you need to land the car safely because later levels don't give you time to fix mistakes. Classic world: This is the main Drive Mad experience, with 200 levels that slowly increase in difficulty. Winter world: This winter-themed world adds a snowy aesthetic to the game with 25 different levels . Monster truck world: This world includes 25 levels where you drive a monster truck with much larger wheels. The added weight makes small mistakes harder to correct, especially in the later stages. Level mechanics These 5 common level mechanics punish repeating the same move and force you to play each level differently. Magnet levels: Drive too close and magnets pull the car, demanding instant corrections to avoid crashing. Low or zero gravity levels: Braking shifts the car's balance instead of slowing it down, making timing more important than speed. Moving machinery levels: Rotating wheels, conveyors, and swinging obstacles knock the car off balance if you enter at the wrong moment. Hazard timing levels: Lasers, shockwaves, and falling objects punish rushed runs and reward patience. Goal-based puzzle levels : Pushing objects and creating pathways from obstacles requires controlled movement rather than raw momentum. Trophies There are 24 trophies to collect in Drive Mad. These trophies reward players who keep coming back . They track everything from having 100 total crashes to completing 50 levels in a row without crashing. There are a number of level-specific trophies as well, such as beating level 1 on your back wheels. These trophies give experienced players a reason to keep pushing long after the main levels stop being enough. Gold time Gold tim

This is their first game on Poki! How do you play Pop It Fidget Games? Find a friend or someone else to play with. Rock, paper, scissors to see who goes first. Players will take turns to choose on row and POP as many bubbles as they want (in that row only). You can pop a bubble by using a mouse or touchscreen. The next player will choose any one row that has any unpopped bubbles and POP as many as they want in that row only. Players will continue taking turns until one player is forced to POP the last bubble. That player loses the round, but don't worry! Flip the board and start over. The first player to win three rounds is the winner. Are there other ways to play Pop It? Yes there are! In the advanced version, the gameplay is the same except the players can only POP bubbles in a row that are directly next to each other without any popped bubbles in between. You can try to pop as fast as possible all the bubbles. Keep track of your fastest time and dare other people to beat your time! Use the Pop It fidget board as a way to relax. One mistake and the monkey will catch you. Play Temple Run 2 and see why over 2 million other players have upvoted it! How Temple Run 2 works In Temple Run 2, your character runs automatically . React before each obstacle reaches you by jumping, sliding or changing lanes at the right moment. The 4 actions you use in every run: Jump: Clear barriers, traps and holes in the path. Slide: Duck under low obstacles and overhanging gates. Turn: Change direction at sharp corners. Change lanes: Shift left or right to collect coins and avoid obstacles. The game starts slow. After the first 500 meters, the run speeds up and obstacles start appearing faster. By 2,000 meters, the run becomes fast enough that even a small delay can end it. Controls Desktop: Up arrow to jump Down arrow to slide Left and right arrows to turn and change lanes Mobile: Swipe up to jump Swipe down to slide Swipe left or right to turn and change lanes Obstacles and difficulty These are the 5 types of obstacles you encounter in every run: Traps: Jump over spinning blades, spiked logs, fire pits and fire-breathing statues. Low gates and fallen trees: Jumping over these is not possible, you need to slide under them. Sharp turns: Left or right turns in the path that come up fast. Broken pathways: Jump or change lanes to avoid holes and broken parts of the path. Zip-lines, mine carts and rivers: Short sections where movement changes. You steer a mine cart, slide down a zip-line or swim side to side. Temple Run 2 maps In Temple Run 2, you run on the Sky Summit map. This is the original map from the 2013 release. At Poki, you can also play 4 additional Temple Run 2 maps as separate games. Each has its own obstacles and visual themes. Frozen Shadows adds icy caves and frozen water slides. Spooky Summit is a Halloween-themed version of Sky Summit. Jungle Fall takes you through dense jungle ruins. Holi Festival covers the path in colour and festival obstacles. Temple Run 2 power-ups Temple Run 2 has 3 power-ups . You can spend coins in the "Abilities" menu to improve each power-up. Coin Magnet: Pulls nearby coins toward you for a short time. Shield: Blocks one obstacle hit. It does not protect against falls. Boost: Lets you move faster and pass through obstacles. Who created Temple Run 2? Temple Run 2 was developed by Imangi Studios and released in 2013, following the success of the original Temple Run from 2011. By 2018, Temple Run 2 passed 500 million downloads on Google Play , making it one of the most downloaded mobile games of all time. Temple Run 2 is available as a mobile app on both iOS and Android. title: Dino Game
controls: Press the Spacebar or Up arrow to jump. On mobile, tap the screen to jump. Hold the input for a long jump.
intro: The Dino Game is an endless runner game where you run through a desert jumping over cactus plants. The longer you run for, the faster the game gets so you need to focus on timing every jump to get a higher score.
description: About The Dino Game Improve your jump timing to survive longer runs and push your score higher with every attempt. This is the classic Chrome Dino browser game , now playable online at Poki. See how long you can keep running in this iconic offline runner! How to play the Dinosaur Game In the Dino Game you run automatically through a pixelated desert. Your only job is to jump at the right moment to avoid the cacti. Mistakes like jumping too late or landing between closely spaced obstacles will end the run instantly. Use this as a lesson to improve your timing in the next run. Dino Game controls You jump to clear obstacles and keep your run alive. Here's how you do it on desktop and mobile: On desktop: Space bar or up arrow On mobile: tap on the screen There are two types of jumps that you can perform in the Dino Game: Short jumps: Quick taps let you clear closely spaced cacti without losing control. Long jumps: Holding the jump gives you extra height and distance, which becomes essential as the speed increases. Obstacles and difficulty scaling You will feel the pressure increase as the game speeds up and the space between obstacles cuts your reaction time to well under a second at higher speeds. Every 100 points triggers a retro-style 'ping' . Early pings feel manageable, but later milestones arrive much faster as the game accelerates. By mastering the jump controls, each failed run will help you judge distance better on your next attempt. The Dino Game high score The highest possible score in the Dino Game is 999,999 . Once you reach that number, the score resets back to 0 . This limit exists because the game was originally designed as a no-internet game . The developers never expected players to survive long enough to need a higher score. Tips to improve your Dino Game score Most runs end within the first few hundred points. Mastering these 2 tips separates short attempts from high-score runs. Jump earlier: As the speed increases, your reflexes will be tested. Jump earlier than you think once this happens. Late jumps end most high-score runs. Focus on rhythm : Focus less on panic jumping and more on keeping a steady jump pattern as obstacles start arriving at a regular pace. Who created the Chrome Dino Game? The Chrome Dino Game is built directly into Google Chrome and appears when there is no internet connection , designed to load instantly as a built-in offline game. It was created in 2014 by Edward Jung, Sebastien Gabriel and Alan Bettes. How to access it with an internet connection To play it with an internet connection on Chrome, enter one of the following into the search bar: chrome://dino chrome://network-error/-106 Similar endless runner games on Poki If you enjoy the reaction-based challenge of the Dino Game, try Dino Run for a similar fast-paced dinosaur runner. If you prefer endless runners with progression systems and visual variety, games like Subway Surfers and Temple Run 2 offer a more modern take on the genre.

controls: Desktop: Move with Left arrow and Right arrow, jump/shoot with Up arrow, pump/block with Down arrow, steal with X, and supershot with Z. description: About Basketball Stars Basketball Stars is about watching your opponent so you can steal the ball at the right moment and get past the defender to score before time runs out. There are no teams to manage and no upgrades to grind. You control every move: steal, block and shoot to score. Play Basketball Stars for free at Poki and step onto the court for fast one-on-one matchups! How Basketball Stars works Each match starts as a one-on-one contest with a simple goal: score more before time runs out. You only get 60 seconds. That's just enough time for a few drives and a steal, or to make one mistake that lets your opponent score before you can recover. The short rounds make it easy to jump straight back in and try again . Miss a play, restart within seconds and try again with a better move. This is where you start blocking shots you used to miss and turning defence into fast points. Now it starts to feel less chaotic . You start spotting chances to steal or drive to the basket faster. Sometimes the whole match comes down to one play. Possession changes instantly , so you must switch from scoring to defending without hesitation. Hesitate for a second and the ball is gone. Act first and you control the play. Controls Desktop: Move: Left and right arrows Jump / shoot: Up arrow Pump / block: Down arrow Dash: Double-tap a direction Steal: X Supershot: Z Mobile: Use touch controls for movement and actions Shooting and scoring Scoring is about getting into the right spot and choosing the right moment to shoot. Getting closer to the basket makes your shots much harder to block. Rushed shots are easier for your opponent to block or steal. The Supershot special move can quickly turn a losing round into a win. Because rounds are so short, one good drive can decide everything . Good timing is often the difference between a win and running out of time. Basketball Stars game modes You can jump into different modes depending on how you want to play. Quick Match is for instant revenge. Lose a round, restart immediately and try to outplay the same matchup. Tournament Mode raises the stakes. Lose one game and the run is over, so every possession feels heavier. Training Mode lets you practise steals and timing before jumping back into real matches. Basketball Stars 2 player mode The 2 player mode in Basketball Stars lets you team up or play against a friend using the same device. There are 3 different 2 player games modes: 1v1: This is the classic you vs your friend in an all out test of skill to see who is the best Basketball Stars player. 2v2: This game mode gives each of you an extra player to play either defense or offense. These players are controlled by the game, not the player. Co-op 2v2: Team up with your friend to take on a team of 2 other players controlled by the game. 2 player controls In 2 player mode, the controls will change so that it's easier to share one keyboard. Player 1: Move: Left and Right arrows Jump / shoot: Up arrow Pump / block: Down arrow D

controls: Up arrow, Down arrow, Left arrow, Right arrow to slide the tiles.
intro: 2048 is a numbers puzzle game where you move numbers around a 4x4 grid to combine them to make bigger numbers. When 2 tiles with the same number touch, they merge and double the number. Merge until you reach the 2048 tile.
description: How 2048 works Your main goal in 2048 is to join matching tiles until you make the 2048 tile . Each merge also adds points to your score, so bigger tiles give you more points. The game is made up of a 4x4 grid. Every move slides all tiles on the board at once. Swipe left and every tile shifts as far left as it can go. When two matching tiles slide into each other, they merge into one tile worth twice as much. Two 4s become an 8. Two 8s become a 16. After each move, a new 2 or 4 tile appears in an empty space . The game ends when the grid is full and no matching tiles can merge. Random swipes can quickly trap large tiles in the middle. Before you move, check where each row or column will end up and check that your move leaves an empty space for your next match. Controls Desktop: Arrow keys Mobile: Swipe in any direction Tips for beginners You can quickly lose the game when your biggest tile gets trapped in the middle and smaller tiles block the spaces around it. Follow these tips and you will get better at 2048: Choose one corner at the start and avoid moving your highest tile away from it. Build the bottom row from biggest to smallest , starting with your highest tile in the corner. Try not to swipe up unless you have no other move, because it can move the tiles in your bottom row out of order. Keep matching numbers beside each other so one swipe can merge several pairs and open more spaces. Who created 2048? 2048 was created by Gabriele Cirulli in 2014. He built the game in one weekend and shared its code online for free. It was based on the earlier game 1024 and also took ideas from the game Threes. Similar games If you enjoy brain games like 2048, these games also let you join matching numbers. 2048 Balls lets you drop numbered balls into a container. Matching balls merge when they hit each other. In Merge to Million , you drag each numbered block into place instead of moving the whole board at once.

title: Moto X3M
controls: Up arrow to accelerate. Down arrow to brake. Left arrow and Right arrow to balance the bike. On mobile, tap the on-screen arrows to perform the same actions.
intro: Moto X3M is a racing game where you ride a dirt bike through tracks packed with spinning saw blades, explosives, collapsing ramps and moving platforms. Perform flips to decrease your time while trying not to crash.
description: About Moto X3M Across 50 different levels , each run tests how well you control your speed and keep the bike balanced over hazards that can cause a crash. With over 4 million player upvotes at Poki , Moto X3M is one of the most popular games. Play it now for free in your browser! How to play Moto X3M Every level starts the moment you move. Your time begins immediately, so press the gas smoothly as soon as the level starts. Your goal is simple: Ride across obstacles and reach the finish without crashing. Most crashes happen when the front wheel lands too hard or the bike tilts too far forward Saw blades, collapsing ramps, moving walls and timed explosives will make you crash if you go too fast. You need to control your speed before each jump instead of holding full throttle the whole time. You will do better if you keep your speed steady across jumps by: Tapping the gas instead of holding it down. Easing off the gas before you drive into moving hazards Keeping the bike level before landing. Crashes do not end the level. You respawn at the last checkpoint , but the timer keeps running, which lowers your star rating. Controls Up arrow: Accelerate Down arrow: Brake Left / Right arrows: Balance the bike On mobile : Use the arrows on-screen to perform the same actions. Balancing in the air is essential. Leaning the bike forward or back helps you land both wheels at once and keep moving through the next obstacle. How to get 3 stars in Moto X3M Stars are based entirely on your finish time . For example, in the first level, you get 3 stars for finishing the level in 13 seconds or less. Front or back flips during long jumps reduce your finish time by 0.5 seconds , making safe flips a key to getting more stars. You can improve your time by: Doing flips at the right moment to finish faster. Remembering where traps appear so you can avoid them next run. Restarting the level if you crash early and lose a lot of time. Bike shop There are 8 bikes to unlock in Moto X3M. You will need to spend stars to buy them. The stars are the same ones that you receive for finishing levels in faster times. So the better you are, the more bikes you can unlock. The bikes mostly change how your rider looks, so better runs still come from careful driving. Here is a breakdown of each bike: Vehicle Price About Starter dirt bike Free Default red dirt bike. Green quad bike 10⭐ Green quad bike with four wheels and a wider stance Red sport bike 20⭐ Red sport bike with a rider wearing a black ninja outfit. Green dirt bike 30⭐ Play as a block-style rider on a green off-road bike. Ghost Rider bike 40⭐ Black cruiser bike with a flaming skull rider. intro: Fortz is a shooting game about destroying your opponent's base in two-player battles. Control a customizable turret, place blocks to protect your fort, and reload your ammo regularly to smash the enemy fortifications.
description: From the creator of Dunkers , Temple of Boom , Golf Zero , and more comes Fortz, the two-player game about destroying your opponent’s base. Use your turret, your wits and a selection of wacky weapons to bring down your enemy! Play Fortz for free with a second player on the same computer for maximum hilarity. This Fortz online version offers a fully-featured level editor for custom carnage, as well as a number of premade levels for you and your friends to destroy each other! It’s time to settle the score – play Fortz on Poki to put an end to any argument between you and a friend! Controls: Player 1: W, A, D - Move (ground) W, S - Aim (turret) D - Shoot S - Place block (ground) Player 2: Up, left, right arrow keys - Move (ground) Up, down arrow keys - Aim (turret) Left arrow key - Shoot Down arrow key - Place block (ground) Tips and tricks: - Don’t forget to regularly reload your turret – it won’t fire if it’s empty! - Check out the level select feature for more interesting block arrangements. About the creator: Fortz is brought to you by Colin Lane Games, based in Stockholm, Sweden. Colin Lane is a one-man development outfit that has also created the smash hits Dunkers , Dunkers 2 , Wrassling , Temple of Boom , and Golf Zero .

title: Little Alchemy 2
controls: Use your mouse to click, drag, and drop items to combine them. Click the clean up button to remove elements from the board. Click the hints button to receive a hint.
intro: Little Alchemy 2 is a crafting game where you combine elements to make new objects. Start with the basics like fire, earth, air and water, then combine them to make more complex objects and even animals like unicorns.
description: How Little Alchemy 2 works Little Alchemy 2 starts you with 4 elements: Fire Earth Air Water Drag one onto another and the game tells you straight away whether a new item appears. Each discovery adds to your inventory and gives you more combinations to try. Try as many as possible - there are 720 different combinations! Every item you find falls into 1 of 4 types: Item type What it means Examples Basic items Items you start with or that unlock automatically Fire, earth, water, air Unlockable items Items that appear only when you hit a certain point in the game Time, life Final items Items that cannot be combined further and only appear in the encyclopedia Unicorn, blackhole Depleted items Items that disappear once you have found every combination they can make Fire, earth Your encyclopedia tracks everything you have discovered, including the combinations that got you there. When your workspace gets too crowded, the clean up button clears it so you can keep going without the clutter. Controls Desktop: Click, drag, and drop items on top of each other to combine them. Mobile: Tap and drag items to combine them. Little Alchemy 2 features Little Alchemy 2 includes 3 main features. Hints: Stuck on a combination? Use the hints button to get a suggestion based on the items you already have. Each hint shows you one item you can make right now. You can earn hints by watching a short video, with up to 3 available at a time. Encyclopedia: The encyclopedia tracks every item you have discovered and the combinations that made them. Tap any item to see its description, what type of item it is, and how it connects to other elements. Clean up: Once your workspace gets crowded, hit the clean up button to clear it. You keep everything in your inventory, so nothing is lost. How to find combinations Most combinations work like things do in real life . Think about how the two things are connected or what they would make together in real life, then try it. You can use this idea for most combinations. When you find a new element, try it with everything you already have. Some results are obvious. Others will surprise you. Here are 7 basic combinations to get you started: Combination Result Fire + Earth Lava Water + Earth Mud Air + Water Mist Air + Air Pressure Fire + Fire Energy Water + Fire Steam Earth + Earth Land Who created Little Alchemy 2? Little Alchemy 2 was created by Recloak , a game company based in Warsaw, Poland. It was released in March 2019 as the second game in the Little Alchemy series. It’s been live on Poki since 2022. App The game is also available as an app on iOS and Android ! If you have the app, you can sign into your account with your email, Google account or Facebook to pick up where you left off and continue playing on Poki! title: Tunnel Rush
controls: Player 1: Left arrow and Right arrow to move. Player 2: A and D to move.
intro: Tunnel Rush is a skill game where you run through increasingly difficult levels in a 3D tunnel. All you need to do is avoid hitting obstacles. Choose higher or lower difficulties for better rewards or play against a friend.
description: About Tunnel Rush Every level tests how quickly you spot openings and move before the walls hit you. The retro 3D tunnel never slows down . Walls rotate toward you while narrow gaps appear without warning. You move left or right instantly, or the run ends. At first you are simply trying to reach the end of a level. After a few attempts, sections that once felt random start to make sense . Now you can move earlier and with more confidence. Play Tunnel Rush in your browser at Poki and put your timing and control to the test! How Tunnel Rush works Instead of running endlessly, Tunnel Rush is structured across 100 levels . Each level adds new shapes and tighter spaces that force you to move more carefully. There are no upgrades or power-ups to rely on. Every level is cleared using movement alone. The game alternates between stages set inside the tunnel and outside it , while the tunnel twists and turns in new ways. This makes it harder to line up your next move. Crashes take one second to reset , which means you are instantly back inside the tunnel trying to beat the section that just caught you. Each attempt gives you only a fraction of a second to adjust , so reacting a little earlier makes later levels much easier. 2 player mode 2 player mode turns the same levels into a reaction race . Both players face identical obstacles at the same time, so the winner is whoever reads the tunnel faster and survives longer. Controls Simple controls keep the focus entirely on execution Player 1: Left and right arrows Player 2: A and D Difficulty and level stars Before starting a level, you can choose a difficulty setting. The setting you choose will dictate how many starts out of 3 you get for completing a level. Difficulty Level reward About Easy ⭐ Slowest speed Medium ⭐⭐ Medium speed Hard ⭐⭐⭐ Fastest speed Higher difficulty does not change the level layout. It increases your movement speed , which means gaps arrive sooner and mistakes are harder to correct. Hard mode gives you less time to react , so positioning must be sharper from the start. Who created Tunnel Rush? Tunnel Rush was created by Deer Cat Games and released on Poki in 2019. The game quickly became one of Poki's most recognized reaction challenges and has received over 1 million player upvotes since release. Deer Cat Games is an independent game developer from London. The original release gained strong traction on Poki, leading to the sequel Tunnel Rush 2 . More games like Tunnel Rush If you enjoy reacting fast and squeezing through narrow gaps., these games apply those same reflexes in different ways. Super Tunnel Rush applies similar tunnel-navigation skills but adds car racing, requiring you to steer precisely while also racing to finish the track first. Subway Surfers tests the same forward-reading reflexes in an endless runner format, where survival depends on spotting obstacles early and switching lanes quickly.</p
